title: Chitra Studio (C) is sending 10x its plan's request rate

context.summary: Chitra Studio (Free plan) sent about 200 requests/s against a plan of 20/s. The rate limiter rejected the extra requests with Retry-After, and its batch uploads were queued at the plan rate. No other tenant slowed down. Over plan 37% of the last 10 minutes.

pending_actions.text: Approve sending Chitra Studio an upgrade offer (Free -> Pro).
Keep the stricter limit for another 10 minutes, or release it now.
